rule.description: rule_id, version, status, jurisdiction, file_sha256, sources[url,title,retrieved_at,source_hash], policy_effect, eligibility_determination

checks.description: Layer EVIDENCE_ASSESSMENT: one entry per modeled policy requirement.

open_items.description: Layer UNKNOWN: requirements/conditions the engine cannot evaluate (e.g. timing_requirement = UNKNOWN_CLOCK | TIMESTAMPS_MISSING).

exposure.description: SNAD only: exposure_floor, documented_additional_costs, unknown_additional_costs, known_lower_bound, total_exposure = UNBOUNDED_BY_CURRENT_MODEL.

digest.description: sha256 over the canonical case snapshot + assessment; identical inputs and rule files give an identical digest.

policy_status.description: Always carried. UNREVIEWED = rules and sources not raw-byte verified; a UI must never present the assessment as an officially verified PayPal interpretation.

display_notice.description: Text a UI must show alongside the assessment.

evidence_fields_assessment.description: Whether the FIELDS named by each policy requirement are present/consistent in the supplied artifacts. Not a statement about PayPal acceptance.

paypal_acceptance.description: No policy text retrieved says an artifact is sufficient proof.

observed_inputs.description: merchant_account_country, claim_category, route, funding_source, paypal_seller_protection_status (status_semantics=UNKNOWN), physical_goods: each SUPPLIED / NOT_SUPPLIED / PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN. Nothing is defaulted.

policy_conditions.description: Conditions that depend on opaque PayPal values: observation (PAYPAL_STATUS_OBSERVED / NOT_SUPPLIED / PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN), status_semantics, POLICY_STATUS_MAPPING (UNKNOWN unless established by primary documentation), state.

uncorroborated_requirements.description: Requirements demonstrated only by merchant assertion.
